hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.rs) d=$(dirname "$f"); p=""; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ "$d" != "." ]; do if [ -f "$d/Cargo.toml" ]; then p=$(awk '/^\[package\]/{f=1;next} /^\[/{f=0} f&&$1=="name"{gsub(/"/,"",$3);print $3;exit}' "$d/Cargo.toml"); [ -n "$p" ] && break; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; case "$p" in "") echo "hook: no Cargo package above $f — skipped cargo check" ;; vibe-collab) echo "hook: vibe-collab is excluded from checks — skipped" ;; *) cargo check -p "$p" 2>&1 | tail -8 ;; esac ;; *.tsx|*.ts) npx --prefix vibecoder tsc --noEmit --project vibecoder/tsconfig.json 2>&1 | tail -5 ;; esac
test -f .vibecli/codegraph.db && echo 'kodegraph code graph present — consider /graph/report, /graph/query, or /graph/status before broad file sweeps (token-reduction substrate)' || true
